prompt: Which statements about the GITHUB_TOKEN are true? Choose all that apply.
explanation: The job token is ephemeral, repo-scoped, and right-sizeable through `permissions:`. A PAT is neither automatically safer nor bound to one job — it is a longer-lived, broader credential, and cross-repo work is precisely where you cannot avoid one.

options.text: It is created for each job and expires with it
It works in any repository owned by your account
The `permissions:` block can narrow it per workflow or job
A personal access token is automatically safer
Reaching another repository you do not own requires different credentials
